analysis.title: GS Vol Views 11 Nov 2026
key_insights: Positioning is light: US net leverage at 5-year lows per GS PB. The vol complex is jittery (GS Panic Index 6.5/10) and options volumes have ballooned, with last Thursday the largest put volume session ever.
Fed speakers and PPI data are the macro catalysts before focus shifts to NVDA earnings next week. The SPX implied move through Friday is 1.10%.

NDX average-stock 1-month ATM implied vol is ~44, but this understates concentrated pain in AI infrastructure names. GS AI Data Center Basket (GSTMTDAT) is realizing ~80 vol over the last month, above its Liberation Day high.

NVDA is down nearly 30% since early October, erasing over $1.75tn in market cap, and trades at ~24x P/E, a valuation not seen since 2019. With vol and skew elevated, the desk favors long delta plus short vol with a 10% downside cushion to add length.

Biopharma has drawn interest post-midterms on secular tailwinds, higher M&A appetite and an expected benefit from a sustained broadening trade. For the second consecutive quarter almost every large cap biopharma company beat on revenue and the majority raised guidance.
Vol of vol had its 2nd largest single-day increase on record (Thursday), followed by a top-10 single-day decline (Monday). Realized vol of VVIX has surged toward all-time highs.

The desk likes owning downside skew in SPX because the street is structurally short vol on the way down and long vol on the way up, which should create an asymmetric bid for protection on any meaningful selloff.
Small caps: positioning is thin ahead of a strong seasonal period and vol has reset near multi-year lows. IWM vol trades near its lowest spread to SPY since Covid.
The desk promotes cross-asset equity/rates hybrids (dual binaries) to express macro views with more precision and leverage, given recent macro data and Fedspeak have put rates back in focus.
